name: Curtains and blinds installation
summary: How expats commission curtains, blinds, and blackout solutions in Singapore rentals — landlord consent, condensation and mould risk, and measuring norms before factory orders.
body:
Window coverings are an early rental spend: west-sun glare, blackout for shift work, and privacy on low floors. Singapore humidity and condo rules make measuring and landlord consent as important as fabric choice.

## Scope
- Curtains / sheers on tracks or rods
- Roller, venetian, and cellular blinds
- Blackout for bedrooms and media rooms
- Motorised options — budget batteries/wiring and after-sales

Many TAs require reinstatement: confirm whether drilling is allowed or tension/damage-free systems are mandatory.

## Measuring and mould
Incorrect width/drop wastes weeks on factory orders. Ask who measures and who owns remake risk. Blackout against sweating glass can trap moisture — leave airflow plans in monsoon-facing rooms and pair with the mould/humidity habits in the rental guides.

## How to choose
Prefer vendors who site-measure, show fabric light-block ratings, and itemise installation vs product. Get written timelines around Chinese New Year factory shutdowns. Compare three quotes on the same fabric code — not only “blackout” as a vague word.

## Practical tip
Photograph bracket positions before install for end-of-lease patching. Keep spare remote batteries for motorised blinds and test every panel before the crew leaves.
